long_biography.plain_text:
Manufacturing executive David Mylrea has made distributor training and feedback part of how Engage Technologies develops its products. During the pandemic, the company created a library of instructional videos and an online training system covering installation, servicing and maintenance. The programme extended technical instruction across its distribution network, alongside training at its own facilities.

Mylrea uses a distributors' council to discuss equipment modifications, product manuals, warranties and customer service. Factory capacity has been another practical priority. Moving the Eastey division to larger premises in Big Lake, Minnesota, removed a testing bottleneck. Staff could test large packaging machines while continuing production elsewhere in the plant.
